title: Don’t use it, you can loose access to your own data!
body: Notes app is horrible! It is lagging while you are typing simple text. With update to iOS 18 I lost acccess to some of my notes (encrypted ones) and I can’t even open them from iCloud. Behaviour is completely unpredictable - e.g. some notes you can open on your iPhone or  iPad but not from iCloud. Some of them you can’t open at all. The fact that you have all notes on iCloud is not helping because you can’t access it.
